title: SB308 (2026 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Senate Draft 2, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2026/bills/SB308_SD2_.HTM; sha256 31d24f2f1221359e7158ec276bef815964d24e9dbdbccaf85c80291108640a8f)
provenance.note: Version read is Senate Draft 2 (SD2), not the as-filed bill. Bill has no recorded passage vote in the data; later amendments are not in the text read. Heading prints 2025 (carried over); effective date printed as January 1, 2026. Strikes only wording ("which" to "that", "no" to "not more than") in the magazine-modification sentence.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (HRS 134-8): The manufacture, possession, sale, barter, trade, gift, transfer, or acquisition of any detachable ammunition magazine with a capacity in excess of thirty rounds that is designed for or capable of use with any firearm other than a pistol is prohibited.
SECTION 2 (uncodified): This Act shall not prohibit possession of a detachable ammunition magazine with a capacity in excess of thirty rounds that is designed for or capable of use with any firearm other than a pistol that was legally obtained prior to the effective date of this Act.
